annotations.title: Pallets that fit in a trailer

description: How many pallets fit on the floor of a trailer, loaded straight, turned, as the best mix or as side-by-side pinwheel lanes, and stacked when loadHeight and stackable are given. Choose equipment from list_equipment and pallet from its ids, or give palletLength and palletWidth in inches for a custom size. weight is the weight of ONE pallet in pounds and is checked against the trailer payload.

loadHeight.description: Loaded pallet height in inches (1–144), used when stackable is true

pallet.description: Pallet id. Ignored when palletLength and palletWidth are given

palletLength.description: Custom pallet length, in inches (12–120). Give with palletWidth

palletWidth.description: Custom pallet width, in inches (12–120). Give with palletLength

stackable.description: Whether the freight can be double-stacked

weight.description: Weight of ONE pallet in pounds (0.1–10000)

name: pallets_per_trailer
title: Pallets that fit in a trailer
